provenance.design: R8-1 (WS-216/ARCH-007, R8-F-020 + R7-CF-REPAIR): manifest-based classification + per-environment anchoring; gzip measured on deterministically normalized content (known hash filenames + build identity)
provenance.tolerances_derivation: raw +8 = 2x the max observed identity-driven minifier identifier-shift (delta 4, R8-0 section 4.3.3); gzip +16 = 2x the conservative post-normalization shift bound (observed convergence 0 on lazy/initial, 4 on normalized entry; R8-0 section 4.3.4); hard caps enforced by the guard (raw<=16, gzip<=256)
provenance.seed_note: R8-1 re-defines the surfaces semantically: lazy = dynamic-only closure from manifest isDynamicEntry roots (the replaced filename heuristic missed 14,228 B of genuinely lazy chunks and misattributed 224,687 B of initial-load chunks as lazy); precache counts UNIQUE URLs (the previous measurement double-counted 31 duplicate URLs generated by overlapping includeAssets/globPatterns globs, +76,466 B - recorded as finding R8-N1, separate track); the service-worker runtime surface (sw.js + workbox-*.js) is guarded for the first time (was an unclassified blind spot). Counts are recorded, not guarded. Entry ceilings 650,000/155,300 remain owned exclusively by check-bundle-budget (D-034/ADR-017).
provenance.history: W8 STR-608/F-11 (2026-10-05) original lazy+precache ratchet; W10 CI-environment gzip anchoring; R7-2/R7-3/R7-4 documented structural-growth updates; R7-CF-REPAIR +512 cross-environment interim bridge; R8-1 per-environment replacement (this schema).
provenance.environment_convergence: all three environments measure identical normalized gzip on the same graph (lazyGzipNormTotal 363974 and initialGzipNormTotal 70716 in local, github-actions, and cloudflare-pages); raw surfaces are identical across environments for the non-entry files; the entry and precache differ by the +112 hex-identity footprint (local null-fallback vs CI/Pages 40-hex SHA)
